notes.title: Sparticles v1.2
notes.content:
New update (v1.2) :
[list]
[*] Display your ranking relative to the leaderboard at the end of a level
[*] Level instantly completed as soon as you reach the end portal if it is unlocked
[*] New interface for selecting levels: now all 100 levels are visible at a glance, no need to scroll for several seconds if you want to reach the last levels
[*] Improved system save settings and add slider to set the sound volume of the music / effects (formerly simple toggles)
[*] Again a change on the design of enemies / projectiles / etc
[/list]

notes.title: Sparticles v1.1
notes.content:
New version of Sparticles ! Here is the list of major changes :
[list]
[*] Major visual improvement of the environment, entities, and particles !
[*] The player and the enemies change color randomly
[*] Improved end scenes as soon as a boss is killed
[*] Reduced difficulty for some levels
[/list]
